source_srs: D:/SRS_Data Science Intelligence Arena/DineIQ Analytics-Data Science Intelligence Arena_SRS.pdf
method: Inspected source, generated-data and result files, app, tests, prior execution logs, model evidence, and a fresh local app/browser run. COMPLETE is reserved for requirements with execution evidence; broader requirements remain PARTIAL where evidence covers only a subset.
status_count_scope: Counts cover the 41 cross-cutting requirements plus 5 individually listed non-functional requirements in this file. results/audit/functional_requirement_matrix.json separately maps every SRS functional requirement FR i-lxvi; results/audit/deliverables_matrix.json maps submission deliverables.

requirements.requirement: Create a synthetic, related restaurant dataset with the required entities and identifiers.
requirements.evidence: 11 generated tables: customers, orders, order_items, menu_items, menu_categories, restaurants, pricing_history, promotions, ratings, inventory, wastage; ordering channel is a column on orders.
requirements.verification: Generation manifest reports 650,000 orders and 3,000,600 order-item rows; generated-data validation and independent validation evidence exist.
requirements.remaining_action: Provide externally hosted full dataset/public access instructions for final submission.

requirements.requirement: Demonstrate current scale and support at least five million order-line rows without redesign.
requirements.evidence: A real Spark workload aggregated exactly 5,000,000 order lines: all 3,000,000 canonical v4 rows plus 2,000,000 disposable prefixed copies. All seven validations passed in 22.135 seconds without materializing the fixture or modifying canonical data; synthetic expansion is not a substitute for a 5M canonical HDFS dataset.
requirements.verification: Full regression: 48 tests passed; security API suite: 8 tests passed; the real Edge/CDP suite passed all eight routes and all interactive/loading/error checks. Canonical v4 read-back and the saved wastage-risk-model reload checks also passed.
requirements.remaining_action: Measure ingestion and storage on a canonical 5M-row dataset if the SRS requires persisted-volume validation.

requirements.evidence: Generated CSV source; canonical processed and analytical outputs are HDFS Parquet.
requirements.verification: V4 HDFS Parquet outputs were read at app startup; app health reports 12 analytics tables loaded.
requirements.remaining_action: Document external sample/full-data and Parquet access strategy.

demand_model_comparison.weekday_semantics_note: Spark training day_of_week maps Sunday=0; Python training uses pandas Monday=0. Python inference here uses its native Monday=0 convention. Both models independently score the same underlying held-out records and target, so per-case outputs are comparable descriptively but not a controlled feature-equivalent model comparison.
